units.source_text: 先生是个不为世人所知的人，因此，对于先生的学问和思想，除了同他关系密切的我之外，是不可能有人满怀敬意的。

en.t: Sensei was a man unknown to the world, and therefore, apart from me, who was closely connected with him, there was no one who could feel deep respect for his learning and thought.
I often said that this was a great pity.

units.source_text: 先生并不介意，只回答说：“像我这样的人，不可能到社会上讲话的。”

en.t: Sensei paid no attention to it, and merely answered, "A person like me has no business going out into society and speaking."

units.source_text: 因先生的回答过于谦虚，我听着倒像是对社会的嘲讽。

en.t: Because Sensei's reply was too humble, it sounded to me instead like a mockery of society.

units.source_text: 事实上，先生对那些现在已成名的老同学，常常毫不客气地进行批评。

en.t: In fact, Sensei often criticized without reserve those old classmates of his who had now become famous.

units.source_text: 于是，我就抓住先生这一矛盾的表现，发了一通议论。

en.t: So I seized on this contradiction in Sensei's behavior and argued the point at length.

units.source_text: 我的精神与其说是反抗的，不如说是为人们非但不理解先生，而且还不以为然感到遗憾。

en.t: My feeling was less one of defiance than regret that people not only failed to understand Sensei, but were also indifferent to him.

units.source_text: 那时，先生语气深沉地说：“我是个没有资格为社会服务的人，没有办法。”

en.t: At that time, Sensei said in a grave tone, "I am a person who has no qualification to serve society. There is nothing to be done."

units.source_text: 先生的脸上清晰地浮现出某种深邃的表情。

en.t: A certain deep expression appeared clearly on Sensei's face.

units.source_text: 我不知道那是失望，还是不满或者悲哀，只觉得毅然决然得使我无言以对，没有勇气再说什么。

en.t: I did not know whether it was disappointment, resentment, or sorrow; I only felt that it was so resolute that I was left speechless and had no courage to say anything more.

units.source_text: 我和夫人聊天时，也很自然地谈论起了先生，最后落到了这个问题上。

en.t: While I was chatting with his wife, our talk quite naturally turned to Sensei, and in the end came around to this question.

units.source_text: “先生为什么只是闷在家里思考、学习，不到社会上做一番事业呢？”

en.t: "Why does Sensei only stay shut up at home thinking and studying, instead of going out into society and doing some work?"
"No, that will not do. He dislikes that sort of thing."
"You mean he thinks such things are pointless?"
